notes.title: Update 1.0.1.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1.1
- Add various treasure items to be sold at the shop. which day and night will affect item spawning (can be found at by camp or common boxes and by valleys)

- Add NPC Merchants to buy various types of items. (Other item shops will be added in future updates)

- Test server system

notes.title: Update 1.0.1.0
notes.content:

- Added status effects to player's monsters when attacking level.
- Added collection and visibility of new items
- You can now collect items from nature. (Plants and Miners)
- Increases monster's level, affects exp and reward items.


- The next update will have a test.
- crafting various items
- Trading items with NPCs because both finding items from boxes
- Test different types of weapons
